messages:
Leah: Legal flagged example outputs that look like real PII. With the v1->v2 deprecation + model alias swap coming, we need a small migration guide, sanitized snippets, and a link audit.
Martin: Got it. I can run a grep for email/phone patterns and replace with <EMAIL>/<PHONE>. Will open small PRs with preview builds.
Ivy: SDK breaking changes to call out: `client.createEmbedding(dimension=...)` -> `client.embeddings.create(vector_dim=...)` and model id renames (`open-quant-7b` -> `redwood-q-7b`). I'll draft side-by-side JS/Python/curl examples.
Rafael: Samples used in onboarding should be first priority. I'll update sample READMEs and add redirects for retired v1 pages.
Leah: Legal prefers a brief footer on sanitized pages: "Examples sanitized for privacy." Keep language consistent.
docs-bot: placeholder PR preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
Martin: Plan: 1) automated replace script, 2) manual review for false positives, 3) incremental PRs. Branch: docs/sanitize-1881.
Ivy: Snippet preview for doc copy:
```js
// v1
await client.models.generate({model: 'redwood-v1', input: 'hi'})
// v2
await client.responses.create({model: 'redwood-v2', input: 'hi'})
```
Ivy: Will also add a compatibility note for teams that can't migrate immediately.
Rafael: CI note: doc-runner needs a transient shim to accept both v1 and v2 names or many smoke tests will fail. I can add `tools/doc-runner/shim-v1-to-v2.js`.
Leah: Assignments: Martin (sanitize script + PRs), Ivy (snippets + migration guide draft), Rafael (samples + doc-runner shim), Leah (legal coordination + redirects). Please paste PR links here as you open them.
Martin: Ack. Opening first sanitize PR tonight.
Ivy: Ack. I'll post snippet branch `docs/snippets-v2-1881`.
Leah: Thanks team 44d Drop PR URLs here and check items off in the migration checklist once merged.
